title: In-Line Chlorination for Drinking Water in Rural Odisha, India: A Randomized Controlled Implementation Trial
abstract:
In-line chlorination automatically treats drinking water in piped water systems, substantially reducing morbidity and mortality while averting the burden of water treatment on individuals. Approximately 2.3 billion people globally use fecally contaminated drinking water infrastructure that is potentially compatible with in-line chlorination. In India, the Ministry of Jal Shakti’s Jal Jeevan Mission has increased access to piped drinking water among rural households, but water is often supplied intermittently without treatment. The aims of this study were to 1) test installation and operations for two in-line chlorination devices (CTI-8 and PurAll 100), 2) evaluate acceptability and adoption of chlorinated water, and 3) assess reductions in drinking water fecal contamination, including with antibiotic resistant bacteria. We conducted a randomized controlled implementation trial of in-line chlorination in 20 villages in Rayagada district, Odisha, India over one year. Data collection included a baseline and post-intervention census (N = 914) and household surveys over six timepoints (N = 1,041) to assess water quality. In the treatment group, we detected chlorine in 51% of tap water samples; this prevalence rose to 78% after increasing the target dose. Despite taste complaints in treatment communities, participants continued using piped water as their primary drinking water source. Individuals in treatment villages spent less time manually treating their drinking water, a responsibility borne by women in 92% of households. Treatment reduced
E. coli
prevalence by 70% in tap water (95% CI: 54%, 80%) and by 47% in stored water (95% CI: 32%, 59%). Treatment also reduced the presence of antibiotic resistant
E. coli
by 67% in stored water (95% CI: 11%, 88%). In-line chlorination can improve water quality, lower the time burden of water treatment, and increase user adoption of chlorinated drinking water, but achieving this requires dedicated implementation and monitoring.
abstract_zh: 管道内氯化可对管道供水系统中的饮用水进行自动处理，在显著降低发病率和死亡率的同时，减轻个人处理水的负担。全球约有23亿人使用可能适用管道内氯化的、受粪便污染的饮用水基础设施。在印度，饮水部（Jal Shakti）的“Jal Jeevan使命”提高了农村家庭获得管道饮用水的机会，但供水往往是间歇性的且未经处理。本研究的目标是：1）测试两种管道内氯化设备（CTI-8和PurAll 100）的安装与运行；2）评估氯化水的可接受性和采用情况；3）评估饮用水粪便污染的降低程度，包括耐抗生素细菌的污染。我们在印度奥里萨邦Rayagada县的20个村庄开展了为期一年的管道内氯化随机对照实施试验。数据收集包括基线和干预后普查（N=914），以及在六个时间点进行的入户调查（N=1041），以评估水质。在处理组中，我们在51%的自来水样本中检测到氯；提高目标剂量后，这一比例升至78%。尽管处理社区存在对口感的抱怨，参与者仍继续将管道水作为其主要饮用水来源。处理村庄中的居民用于手动处理饮用水的时间减少了，而这一责任在92%的家庭中由女性承担。处理使自来水中大肠杆菌（E. coli）的检出率降低了70%（95%置信区间：54%，80%），储存水中降低了47%（95%置信区间：32%，59%）。处理还使储存水中耐抗生素大肠杆菌的存在降低了67%（95%置信区间：11%，88%）。管道内氯化可以改善水质，减少水处理的时间负担，并提高用户对氯化饮用水的采用率，但实现这一目标需要专门的实施与监测。

title: The Effect of Reminders for Self-Set Goals on Productivity
Decision-oriented benchmarking to transform AI weather forecast access: Application to the Indian monsoon
abstract: Artificial intelligence weather prediction (AIWP) models now often outperform traditional physics-based models on common metrics while requiring orders-of-magnitude less computing resources and time. Open-access AIWP models thus hold promise as transformational tools for helping low- and middle-income populations make decisions in the face of high-impact weather shocks. Yet, current approaches to evaluating AIWP models focus mainly on aggregated meteorological metrics without considering local stakeholders' needs in decision-oriented, operational frameworks. Here, we introduce such a framework that connects meteorology, AI, and social sciences. As an example, we apply it to the 150-year-old problem of Indian monsoon forecasting, focusing on benefits to rain-fed agriculture, which is highly susceptible to climate change. AIWP models skillfully predict an agriculturally relevant onset index at regional scales weeks in advance when evaluated out-of-sample using deterministic and probabilistic metrics. This framework informed a government-led effort in 2025 to send 38 million Indian farmers AI-based monsoon onset forecasts, which captured an unusual weeks-long pause in monsoon progression. This decision-oriented benchmarking framework provides a key component of a blueprint for harnessing the power of AIWP models to help large vulnerable populations adapt to weather shocks in the face of climate variability and change.
abstract_zh: 人工智能天气预报（AIWP）模型现在在常见指标上往往优于传统的基于物理的模型，同时所需计算资源和时间少了几个数量级。开放获取的AIWP模型因此有望成为变革性工具，帮助低收入和中等收入人群在面对高影响天气冲击时做出决策。然而，目前评估AIWP模型的方法主要关注汇总的气象指标，而未考虑当地利益相关者在以决策为导向的业务框架中的需求。在此，我们提出了这样一个将气象学、人工智能和社会科学联系起来的框架。作为示例，我们将其应用于已有150年历史的印度季风预报问题，重点关注对雨养农业的益处，而雨养农业对气候变化高度敏感。当使用确定性和概率性指标进行样本外评估时，AIWP模型能够在区域尺度上提前数周准确预测一个与农业相关的季风开始指数。该框架为政府在2025年开展的一项行动提供了依据，该行动向3800万印度农民发送了基于人工智能的季风开始预报，这些预报成功捕捉到了季风推进中一次罕见的长达数周的停滞。这一以决策为导向的基准评估框架，为利用AIWP模型的力量、帮助大量脆弱人群在气候变率和变化面前适应天气冲击的蓝图提供了关键组成部分。

title: Designing probabilistic AI monsoon forecasts to inform agricultural decision-making
abstract: Subsetted AI-based weather prediction (AIWP) forecast datasets for daily precipitation over the Indian region. Daily precipitation is provided on a 2° × 2° spatial grid, obtained via conservative regridding from each model’s native resolution. Daily precipitation from the Meteorological Department (IMD) at the same 2° ×2° resolution is also provided. The datasets span multiple analysis periods and are organized as yearly NetCDF (.nc) files.

Water Treatment and Child Mortality: Evidence from Kenya
abstract: Each year, around 500,000 children under 5 die from diarrhea, making it the third-leading cause of death in this age group. More than 80 percent of these deaths are attributable to unsafe drinking water. Drinking water can be made safe through dilute chlorine solution, but take-up of this technology has been low. Previous work has shown that free community-wide provision of dilute chlorine solution through "dispensers" -reservoirs of chlorine solution at water sources that make chlorination easy and free -increases take-up of chlorination. However, it has remained unclear whether this increase also translates into reduced mortality. Here we show that four years of community-wide provision of dilute chlorine solution in rural Kenya reduces allcause under-5 mortality by 1.4 percentage points (95% CI: 0.3 pp, 2.5 pp), a 63% reduction relative to control. We estimate that at USD 25 per DALY averted, free provision of chlorine solution is twenty times more cost-effective than the WHO "highly cost-effective" threshold.
abstract_zh: 每年约有50万名5岁以下儿童死于腹泻，使其成为该年龄段的第三大死因。这些死亡中超过80%可归因于不安全的饮用水。饮用水可以通过稀释氯溶液变得安全，但该技术的采用率一直很低。既往研究表明，通过“分配器”（即在水源处设置氯溶液储罐，使加氯变得容易且免费）在社区范围内免费提供稀释氯溶液，可以提高加氯的采用率。然而，这一采用率的提高是否也能转化为死亡率的下降，仍不清楚。本文表明，在肯尼亚农村地区，在社区范围内连续四年免费提供稀释氯溶液，使5岁以下儿童的全因死亡率下降了1.4个百分点（95%置信区间：0.3个百分点，2.5个百分点），相对于对照组下降了63%。我们估计，按每避免一个伤残调整生命年（DALY）25美元计算，免费提供氯溶液的成本效益比世界卫生组织“极具成本效益”的阈值高出二十倍。

title: Realizing the Potential of Digital Development: The Case of Agricultural Advice
abstract: The rapid spread of mobile phones creates potential for sustainably raising agricultural productivity for the 2 billion people living in smallholder farming households. Meta-analyses suggest that providing agricultural information via digital technologies increased yields by 4% and the odds of adopting recommended inputs by 22%. Benefits likely exceed the cost of information transmission by an order of magnitude. The spread of GPS-enabled smartphones could increase these benefits by enabling customized information, thus incentivizing farmers to contribute information to the system. Well-known distortions in markets for information limit the ability of such systems to reach the socially efficient scale through purely commercial means. There is a clear role for public support for digital agricultural extension, but messages designed by agricultural ministries are often difficult for farmers to understand and use. Realizing the potential of mobile communication systems requires feedback mechanisms to enable rigorous testing and continuous improvement.
abstract_zh: 手机的迅速普及，为全球约20亿生活在小农家庭中的人口可持续地提高农业生产率创造了潜力。元分析表明，通过数字技术提供农业信息可使产量提高4%，并使采用推荐投入品的概率提高22%。其收益很可能比信息传输成本高出一个数量级。配备GPS的智能手机的普及，可以通过提供定制化信息来增加这些收益，从而激励农民向系统贡献信息。信息市场中众所周知的扭曲，限制了此类系统仅通过商业手段达到社会有效规模的能力。公共部门支持数字农业推广显然有其作用，但农业部门设计的信息往往难以被农民理解和使用。要实现移动通信系统的潜力，需要建立反馈机制，以便进行严格检验和持续改进。

Nudging Farmers to Use Fertilizer: Theory and Experimental Evidence from Kenya
abstract: While many developing country policymakers see heavy fertilizer subsidies as critical to raising agricultural productivity, most economists see them as distortionary, regressive, environmentally unsound, and argue that they result in politicized, inefficient distribution of fertilizer supply. We model farmers as facing small fixed costs of purchasing fertilizer, and assume some are stochastically present-biased and not fully sophisticated about this bias. Even when relatively patient, such farmers may procrastinate, postponing fertilizer purchases until later periods, when they may be too impatient to purchase fertilizer. Consistent with the model, many farmers in Western Kenya fail to take advantage of apparently profitable fertilizer investments, but they do invest in response to small, time-limited discounts on the cost of acquiring fertilizer (free delivery) just after harvest. Later discounts have a smaller impact, and when given a choice of price schedules, many farmers choose schedules that induce advance purchase. Calibration suggests such small, time-limited discounts yield higher welfare than either laissez faire or heavy subsidies by helping present-biased farmers commit to fertilizer use without inducing those with standard preferences to substantially overuse fertilizer.
abstract_zh: 许多发展中国家的政策制定者认为，大量的化肥补贴对提高农业生产率至关重要，而大多数经济学家则认为，这些补贴具有扭曲性、累退性，且对环境不利，并认为它们导致化肥供应的分配受到政治干扰且效率低下。我们将农民建模为面临购买化肥的小额固定成本，并假设其中一部分农民随机地存在现时偏好，且对这一偏误认识并不充分。即使相对有耐心，这类农民也可能拖延，将化肥购买推迟到之后的时期，而到那时他们可能过于不耐烦而不愿购买化肥。与模型相符，西肯尼亚的许多农民没有利用明显有利可图的化肥投资机会，但他们会对收获后短暂的、有时限的化肥取得成本折扣（免费配送）做出投资反应。之后的折扣影响较小，而且在可以选择不同价格方案时，许多农民会选择诱导提前购买的方案。校准结果表明，这类小额、有时限的折扣所带来的福利，高于自由放任或大规模补贴，因为它帮助存在现时偏好的农民承诺使用化肥，同时又不会使具有标准偏好的农民大量过度施用化肥。

title: Peer Effects and the Impacts of Tracking: Evidence from a Randomized Evaluation in Kenya
Spring Cleaning: Rural Water Impacts, Valuation and Property Rights Institutions
abstract: In many societies, social norms create common property rights in natural resources, limiting incentives for private investment. This paper uses a randomized evaluation in Kenya to measure the health impacts of investments to improve source water quality through spring protection, estimate the value that households place on spring protection, and simulate the welfare impacts of alternative water property rights norms and institutions, including common property, freehold private property, and alternative "Lockean" property rights norms. We find that infrastructure investments reduce fecal contamination by 66% at naturally occurring springs, cutting child diarrhea by one quarter. While households increase their use of protected springs, travel-cost based revealed preference estimates of households' valuations are only one-half stated preference valuations and are much smaller than levels implied by health planners' typical valuations of child mortality, consistent with models in which the demand for health is highly income elastic. Simulations suggest that, at current income levels, private property norms would generate little additional investment while imposing large static costs due to spring owners' local market power, but that private property norms might function better than common property at higher income levels. Alternative institutions, such as "modified Lockean" property rights, government investment or vouchers for improved water, could yield higher social welfare.
abstract_zh: 在许多社会中，社会规范为自然资源创造了共同产权，从而限制了私人投资的激励。本文利用肯尼亚的随机评估，衡量通过泉水保护改善水源质量的投资对健康的影响，估计家庭对泉水保护的估值，并模拟替代性水产权规范和制度（包括共同产权、自由保有的私有产权，以及替代性的“洛克式”产权规范）的福利影响。我们发现，在天然泉水处，基础设施投资使粪便污染减少66%，使儿童腹泻减少四分之一。家庭在增加对受保护泉水使用的同时，基于出行成本的显示偏好估计值仅为陈述偏好估值的一半，且远小于卫生规划者对儿童死亡率的典型估值所隐含的水平，这与健康需求具有高收入弹性的模型相一致。模拟表明，在当前收入水平下，私有产权规范几乎不会产生额外投资，同时由于泉水所有者的地方市场势力而带来巨大的静态成本；但在较高收入水平下，私有产权规范可能比共同产权运行得更好。替代性制度，例如“修正的洛克式”产权、政府投资或改善用水的代金券，可以带来更高的社会福利。

Providing Safe Water: Evidence from Randomized Evaluations
abstract: This paper uses a public economics framework to review evidence from randomized trials on domestic water access and quality in developing countries and to assess the case for subsidies. Water treatment can cost-effectively reduce reported diarrhea. However, many consumers have low willingness to pay for cleaner water; few households purchase household water treatment under retail models. Free point-of-collection water treatment systems designed to make water treatment convenient and salient can generate take-up of approximately 60% at a projected cost as low as $20 per year of life saved, comparable to vaccine costs. In contrast, the limited existing evidence suggests that many consumers value better access to water, but it does not yet demonstrate that better access improves health. The randomized impact evaluations reviewed have also generated methodological insights on a range of topics, including (a) the role of survey effects in health data collection, (b) methods to test for sunk-cost effects, (c) divergence in revealed preference and stated preference valuation measures, and (d) parameter estimation for structural policy simulations.
abstract_zh: 本文运用公共经济学框架，回顾了发展中国家关于家庭供水可及性与水质的随机试验证据，并评估了补贴的理由。水处理能够以较高的成本效益降低报告的腹泻发病率。然而，许多消费者为获得更清洁的水所愿意支付的金额很低；在零售模式下，很少有家庭购买家用水处理设备。为使水处理便利且醒目而设计的、在取水点免费提供的水处理系统，可以达到约60%的采用率，且估计每挽救一个生命年的成本低至20美元，与疫苗成本相当。相比之下，现有的有限证据表明，许多消费者重视更好的供水可及性，但尚未证明更好的可及性能够改善健康。所回顾的随机化影响评估也在多个议题上产生了方法论上的见解，包括（a）调查效应在健康数据收集中的作用，（b）检验沉没成本效应的方法，（c）显示偏好与陈述偏好估值度量之间的差异，以及（d）结构性政策模拟的参数估计。

title: The Illusion of Sustainability
abstract: The history of foreign development assistance is one of movement away from addressing immediate needs to a focus on the underlying causes of poverty. A recent manifestation is the move towards "sustainability," which stresses community mobilization, education, and cost-recovery. This stands in contrast to the traditional economic analysis of development projects, with its focus on providing public goods and correcting externalities. We examine evidence from randomized evaluations on strategies for combating intestinal worms, which affect one in four people worldwide. Providing medicine to treat worms was extremely cost effective, although medicine must be provided twice per year indefinitely to keep children worm-free. An effort to promote sustainability by educating Kenyan school children on worm prevention was ineffective, and a "mobilization" intervention from psychology failed to boost de-worming drug take-up. Take-up was highly sensitive to drug cost: a small increase in cost led to an 80 percent reduction in take-up (relative to free treatment). The results suggest that, in the context we examine, the pursuit of sustainability may be an illusion, and that in the short-run, at least, external subsidies will remain necessary.
abstract_zh: 对外国发展援助的历史，是一段从应对迫切需求转向关注贫困根源的历程。近期的一个表现是转向“可持续性”，强调社区动员、教育和成本回收。这与发展项目的传统经济分析形成对比，后者侧重于提供公共品和纠正外部性。我们考察了关于防治肠道寄生虫（全球四分之一的人口受其影响）策略的随机评估证据。提供驱虫药物具有极高的成本效益，但药物必须每年提供两次，且需长期持续，才能使儿童保持无蠕虫状态。一项通过教育肯尼亚学童预防蠕虫感染来促进可持续性的努力是无效的，而来自心理学的“动员”干预未能提高驱虫药物的采用率。采用率对药物成本高度敏感：成本的小幅增加导致采用率（相对于免费治疗）下降80%。结果表明，在我们所考察的情境下，追求可持续性可能是一种幻觉，至少在短期内，外部补贴仍将是必要的。
